all.title: ArtHOI: Taming Foundation Models for Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Hand-Articulated-Object Interactions

all.title: ChartNet: A Million-Scale, High-Quality Multimodal Dataset for Robust Chart Understanding

all.title: CREval: An Automated Interpretable Evaluation for Creative Image Manipulation under Complex Instructions

FIPO: Eliciting Deep Reasoning with Future-KL Influenced Policy Optimization
all.summary: FIPO enhances reinforcement learning for language models by using discounted future-KL divergence to improve credit assignment and extend reasoning chains, achieving better mathematical problem-solving performance.

all.title: MMFace-DiT: A Dual-Stream Diffusion Transformer for High-Fidelity Multimodal Face Generation
all.summary: A unified dual-stream diffusion transformer model enables synergistic multimodal face synthesis by jointly processing spatial and semantic tokens through shared attention mechanisms while maintaining flexibility across different input conditions.

all.title: Lingshu-Cell: A generative cellular world model for transcriptome modeling toward virtual cells
all.summary: Lingshu-Cell is a masked discrete diffusion model that learns transcriptomic state distributions and enables conditional simulation of cellular perturbations across diverse tissues and species.

all.title: TAPS: Task Aware Proposal Distributions for Speculative Sampling
all.summary: Speculative decoding effectiveness depends on draft model training data alignment with downstream tasks, with specialized drafters performing better when combined through confidence-based routing rather than simple averaging.

all.title: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models
all.summary: MonitorBench is introduced as a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating chains of thought monitorability in large language models, revealing that monitorability decreases when structural reasoning is not required and that both open- and closed-source models exhibit reduced monitorability under stress-testing conditions.

all.title: VGGRPO: Towards World-Consistent Video Generation with 4D Latent Reward
all.summary: VGGRPO enhances video diffusion models with latent geometry guidance to improve geometric consistency and camera stability while avoiding expensive VAE decoding.

all.title: daVinci-LLM:Towards the Science of Pretraining
all.summary: The study explores pretraining methodology through an open scientific approach, demonstrating that data processing depth and adaptive curriculum strategies significantly impact model capability development.

all.title: CARLA-Air: Fly Drones Inside a CARLA World -- A Unified Infrastructure for Air-Ground Embodied Intelligence
all.summary: CARLA-Air integrates high-fidelity driving and multirotor flight simulation within a unified Unreal Engine framework, supporting joint air-ground agent modeling with photorealistic environments and multi-modal sensing capabilities.

all.title: On-the-fly Repulsion in the Contextual Space for Rich Diversity in Diffusion Transformers
all.summary: Diffusion transformers can generate diverse visual outputs by applying repulsion in contextual space during the forward pass, maintaining visual quality and semantic accuracy while operating efficiently in streamlined models.

all.title: Tabular LLMs for Interpretable Few-Shot Alzheimer's Disease Prediction with Multimodal Biomedical Data
all.summary: A domain-adapted tabular large language model framework demonstrates improved few-shot Alzheimer's disease classification performance over traditional methods while maintaining stability under missing data conditions.

all.title: BizGenEval: A Systematic Benchmark for Commercial Visual Content Generation
all.summary: A new benchmark called BizGenEval is introduced to evaluate image generation models on commercial visual content creation tasks across multiple document types and capability dimensions.

all.title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report
all.summary: KAT-Coder-V2 employs a specialized-agentic approach with domain-specific fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, enhanced by novel training methods and infrastructure for improved code generation performance.

all.title: Think Anywhere in Code Generation
all.summary: Think-Anywhere is a novel reasoning mechanism that enables large language models to invoke thinking on-demand during code generation, improving performance across multiple benchmarks through adaptive reasoning allocation.

all.title: Extend3D: Town-Scale 3D Generation
all.summary: An object-centric 3D generative model is extended with adaptive latent space and iterative refinement to generate complete 3D scenes from single images, incorporating noise-aware completion and 3D-aware optimization for improved fidelity.

all.title: FlowPIE: Test-Time Scientific Idea Evolution with Flow-Guided Literature Exploration
all.summary: FlowPIE presents a novel retrieval-generation framework for scientific idea generation that uses flow-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search and genetic algorithm principles to produce diverse, high-quality ideas through iterative evolution and cross-domain knowledge integration.

all.title: Distilling Conversations: Abstract Compression of Conversational Audio Context for LLM-based ASR
all.summary: Multimodal conversational context improves LLM-based speech recognition, and abstract compression reduces computational overhead by replacing audio sequences with learned latent tokens while preserving transcripts.

all.title: A Comparative Study in Surgical AI: Datasets, Foundation Models, and Barriers to Med-AGI
all.summary: Current vision language models struggle with surgical tool detection despite large-scale training, indicating fundamental limitations beyond compute and data availability.
